entries.title: Snapshot 26w44a: the Home Update begins
entries.subtitle: Try the Hearth, chests, beds, doors and more before 0.3.0. Back up your worlds first.
bullets: The Hearth: claim a home, earn Comfort, get Rested, buy upgrades
Chests, beds, doors, trapdoors, ladders, fences, walls, panes, slabs, stairs and signs
Inventory sorting, quick stack (G) and richer food and tool tooltips
entries.body:
The first test build of the Home Update. Place a Hearth to make a home. Right-click it to see your Comfort, which comes from walls and a roof, light, a bed, storage and decoration. Comfort gives you Rested while you're at home: faster healing and bonus XP. Spend XP levels on three Hearth upgrades: Wider Claim, Whole Home and Warm Glow. New building blocks arrive too: chests that join into double chests, beds in 16 colours (creative only for now: wool arrives in a later update) that skip the night and work as a backup respawn point, doors, trapdoors and ladders, fences, gates, walls, glass panes, iron bars, slabs, stairs and signs (writing on them comes in the next snapshot). Sort a chest with a middle-click on its empty space, press G to quick-stack your items into nearby chests that already hold them, and hover food or tools to see more in their tooltips. You'll also find Skywright tablets and the Anchor blocks in the creative Skywright tab, and status effect icons in the Shattered Sky theme.

What to test: build a small house around a Hearth and watch your Comfort climb as you add a roof, light, a bed, a chest and decoration. Stay home a while to get Rested, sleep in a bed at night (beds are in creative for now), and try buying an upgrade. Place chests side by side, sort them, and quick-stack into them. Try every new block, especially doors, gates, slabs and stairs.

Snapshots can be unstable, so back up your worlds before trying one. The recipe browser, sign editor, sleeping screen and chest peek arrive in the next snapshots.

entries.title: Blockcraft: Skywright 0.2.2
entries.subtitle: The creative inventory joins the Shattered Sky, plus menu fixes.
bullets: Shattered Sky creative inventory with search and item counts
Options text wraps instead of cutting off at large GUI scales
Clearer digits, resource pack tooltips and an orange furnace flame
entries.body: The creative inventory now has the Shattered Sky look: a row of icon tabs with Search first, a search bar (search by name, or try #food or @blockcraft), item counts, a slim scrollbar, and a Survival Inventory tab with your armour, your character and a red Destroy slot. Menus read better at large GUI scales: Options labels, theme names and key binds wrap onto a second line instead of being cut off, and hovering a resource pack shows its full name and description. The digits 5 and 7 no longer look like S and L, the Default pack shows the Skywright icon, the lit furnace flame glows orange, and in the Shattered Sky theme the hotbar and status bars step aside while a container is open. Classic is unchanged apart from the fixes, and your 0.2.1 worlds open as they are. Next up: the Home Update (0.3.0), with the Hearth, chests, beds and much more.

entries.title: Blockcraft: Skywright 0.2.1, the UI Refresh
entries.subtitle: A brand-new look for every menu, inspired by the Shattered Sky.
bullets: Shattered Sky UI theme, with Classic still available
New title screen, world list, options, inventory and HUD
Pixel fonts, smoother menus and Reduce UI Motion
entries.body: Blockcraft is now Blockcraft: Skywright, and every screen has a new look. The Shattered Sky theme gives the title screen, world list, Create New World, options, pause menu, loading screen, inventory, containers, chat and HUD dark night-sky panels, teal Skyshard accents and crisp pixel fonts. The world list can sort, duplicate worlds and open their folders, the title screen has a Continue button for your last world, the loading screen shows tips, and Options has a search bar and categories. Prefer the old look? Switch to the Classic theme in Options: it keeps Java Edition's style, works with Minecraft resource packs, and has every new feature too. Your 0.2.0 worlds open unchanged.

entries.title: Launcher 1.2.1: Play page fix
entries.body: The Play page now fits smaller launcher windows: the news title and patch notes no longer slide under the sidebar. The launcher updates itself to 1.2.1 the next time it starts online.

entries.title: Launcher 1.2.0: Blockcraft: Skywright
entries.subtitle: A new home screen, a Skins page and a new icon.
bullets: New Play page with patch notes and recent news
Skins page; Logs moved into Settings
Two looks: Shattered Sky or Classic (1.1 look)
entries.body: The launcher is renamed Blockcraft: Skywright and gets the new Shattered Sky look: a sidebar with Play, Installations, Skins, Patch Notes and Settings, a Play page with the latest patch notes and recent news, and a centered PLAY button. Prefer the old design? Settings › Look › Classic (1.1 look) brings it back, with every new page included, and both looks have dark and light modes. The app and installers have a new teal Skywright icon. The launcher updates itself to 1.2.0 the next time it starts online.

entries.title: Blockcraft 0.2.0: the Survival Update
entries.subtitle: Tools, ores, hunger, armor, furnaces, water and lava.
bullets: Tool tiers, durability, new ores, hunger, armor and experience
Furnaces and smelting, with experience when you take the result
Flowing water and lava, buckets, swimming and falling sand
entries.body: The Survival Update is here. Tools now have tiers and durability, and blocks need the right tool to drop. New ores: copper, lapis, redstone and emerald. Hunger, damage, air and death work at Java Edition's numbers, with a death screen and respawning at your bed. Armor protects you, wears down and shows on your player. Build a furnace to smelt ores and food, and collect experience when you take the result. Water and lava flow, mix into cobblestone, stone and obsidian, and can be carried in buckets. You can swim and sprint-swim, sand and gravel fall, and new particles and HUD bars round it out. The Game Menu pauses singleplayer, while inventories and containers keep the world running. Worlds from 0.1.0 open in 0.2.0 and are backed up automatically the first time. Known issue: the new sounds are placeholders and will be replaced in a later update.

entries.title: Launcher 1.1.0: a new look
entries.body: The Blockcraft Launcher now matches the game's new Blockcraft theme. Every screen and dialog uses square pixel panels with crisp borders, beveled green, slate and red buttons, a big pixel PLAY button and the Pixelify Sans and Silkscreen pixel fonts. The header has the new BLOCKCRAFT wordmark, the sidebar has pixel icons, and the Play page shows the selected installation over the artwork with the latest news beside it. The light theme is restyled to match. Everything works as before; the launcher updates itself to 1.1.0 the next time it starts online.

entries.title: Snapshot 26w43a
entries.body: The first snapshot of the Survival Update (0.2.0). Tools now have tiers and durability (wood 59, stone 131, iron 250, gold 32, diamond 1561), blocks need the right tool to drop, and ores drop raw iron, raw gold and raw copper. New ores: copper, lapis, redstone and emerald. Hoes, buckets and all armor pieces exist (armor and buckets start working in later snapshots). Menus no longer pause the world. Worlds now remember the version they were last played in and warn before opening in an older one. Snapshots can damage your world: the first time a 0.1.0 world opens it is backed up automatically, but do not open snapshot worlds in 0.1.0.

entries.title: Welcome to Blockcraft
entries.body: Blockcraft is an original voxel sandbox. Build, explore and survive. This news feed is read by the Blockcraft Launcher from news.json next to the version manifest.
